# WH347form.com

Free WH-347 certified payroll generator and certified payroll automation for
subcontractors on US public works projects (Davis-Bacon / prevailing wage).

- Free WH-347 generator (no signup, browser-only): https://www.wh347form.com/wh-347-generator
- What is a certified payroll report: https://www.wh347form.com/certified-payroll-report
- How to fill out form WH-347: https://www.wh347form.com/how-to-fill-out-wh-347
- California DIR eCPR guide: https://www.wh347form.com/california-dir-ecpr
- Certified payroll Excel template comparison: https://www.wh347form.com/certified-payroll-excel-template

receive a checked WH-347 PDF plus California DIR eCPR XML weekly. Contact:
